title: Design DNA
description: The exhaustive record of one visual identity. Written for you and for build tools, never pasted into a prompt. The prompt payload is compiled from this file into PROMPT.md under a 2KB cap.

meta.description: Provenance. What this is, where it came from, and what must never be reproduced.

name.description: Human name of the style, e.g. 'Cold Press Editorial'.

slug.description: kebab-case. Becomes the emitted skill folder name and its slash command.

source.description: Paths or URLs of the reference artefacts this was measured from.

captured.description: ISO date the capture was made. Styles age; a dated record tells you when to re-measure.

not_copied.description: Real logos, wordmarks, licensed photographs, proprietary typefaces. Reproduce the SYSTEM, never the MARKS. Name the substitute used for each.

medium_of_origin.description: What the reference actually was: website, poster, carousel, deck, motion graphic. The format is an output, not the subject.

confidence_notes.description: Step 7 output: every value inferred rather than measured, and every rule under 70% confidence. This is where the style drifts first.

soul.description: The compression key. Read this alone and you are most of the way there.

one_line.description: Max 160 chars. Concrete nouns only. No marketing words, no 'premium', no 'clean'.

lineage.description: The family tree: Swiss editorial, 90s rave flyer, brutalist web, Memphis, ECM sleeve.

read_distance.description: How far away it is read from. This sets the minimum type size, so it is a functional field, not a poetic one.

energy.description: Each 1-10. A fingerprint that catches drift no single value does.

density.description: How much of the canvas is occupied.

variance.description: How much elements differ from each other. Low = systematic, high = collaged.

palette.description: Colour AND its proportions. The same three hex codes at 60/30/10 and at 90/8/2 are two unrelated designs.

name.description: Descriptive, not systematic. 'dusty plum' travels to an image model; 'accent-500' does not.

coverage.description: Percentage of canvas per role, summing to roughly 100. The most-skipped and most-decisive field in the whole document.

banned.description: Colour behaviours forbidden: gradients, two accents in one frame, pure #000000.

type.description: Families, and above all the ratio between them. 8-to-1 and 2-to-1 are different designs with identical fonts.

fallback.description: REQUIRED. Silent Arial substitution is the most common way a reproduction dies quietly.

display_to_body_ratio.description: The typographic signature. Record it as a floor too ('8x, never under 6x').

measure.description: Characters per line. Under 65 for body is the usual bound.

space.description: USE PERCENTAGES. One spec must drive a 1080x1350 carousel and a 1920x1080 slide without a rewrite. Pixel values here are the reason a spec works on a slide and breaks on a carousel.

alignment.description: Where things line up, and what is deliberately never centred.

rhythm.description: The spacing progression, e.g. 'x1.5 geometric off a 8px base'.

negative_space.description: Where the emptiness is and how big. Emptiness is a placed element, not leftover.

surface.description: What the thing is physically made of.

edges.description: Radii, hairline weights, whether anything bleeds off canvas.

elevation.description: Often the honest answer is 'none'. Record the absence.

imagery.description: Treatment: duotone, grain, crop discipline, subject distance.

signatures.description: The payload. Carry these and nothing else and it is still recognisable. To add a tenth you must delete one; the cap forces a decision instead of shipping indecision.

move.description: Name it like a technique, so it can be referred to in one word.

how.description: AS A RATIO OR RELATIONSHIP. Style is formally the correlation between features, not the features.

when.description: Where in a piece or a sequence it appears.

never.description: How it gets used wrong. The failure mode, written down.

weird_move.description: The single deliberate break in the system. Its own key, deliberately, so it can never get buried in the middle of a document. Highest-information element present and the first thing a mechanical extraction loses.

archetypes.description: Named layouts. Without these you get consistent styling and inconsistent structure, which reads as sloppiness: output #8 will not sit beside output #1 as a set.

purpose.description: Its job in a sequence: opener, proof, quote, closer.

content_shape.description: The content budget: max words per slot.

motion.description: Omit entirely for static work. Restraint is a signature too, which is why never_moves is required when this key exists.

reduced_motion.description: The prefers-reduced-motion fallback. Not optional in shipped work.

voice.description: Copy is part of the design. Right layout, wrong sentence, broken look.

bans.description: Written as absolutes, starting with 'Never'. A positive instruction has to out-vote the training average; a ban deletes the landslide from the options. One ban can rule out an entire space in one line. Bans should outnumber positive style rules.

tests.description: 8 to 12. Binary and measurable. If two people could disagree about the answer, it is not a test. A spec with no failing test is a mood board with better formatting.

check.description: Stated so the answer is yes or no, or a number against a bound.

auto.description: True if a script could decide it. Those go into tools/check.py.

reconstruction.description: Step 5. A spec that has never been used to rebuild its own source has never been tested at all.

gaps_found.description: Every difference found between rebuild and original, and the field added to close it. Expect these to be things you were sure were obvious.

stranger_test.description: Whether a stranger could still pick the copy from the original, and how you checked.
